related.label: Customer Service Code on the shop TV (5 min)

quiz.q: A customer walks in while you are on a phone call to a friend. What do you do?
options: Acknowledge them, end the call and greet them within 10 seconds
quiz.why: Greet within 10 seconds and keep your phone away from customers.

quiz.q: A customer asks for your personal number so they can reach you easily.
options: Give your MoMo number so they can pay you
quiz.why: No personal phone or MoMo number is ever given. Payments go to the company number or the till.

quiz.q: You are not sure of the price of a large print.
options: Guess a price that sounds right
Say 'Let me check' and ask a colleague or the manager
Tell the customer it is expensive
quiz.why: Never guess prices. Check first.

quiz.q: You made a spelling mistake on a customer's print. What do you do?
options: Tell them, apologise and reprint free of charge
quiz.why: Own the mistake and fix it at no extra charge.

quiz.q: Where do you reply to a customer's questions, send receipts and record payments?
options: The customer's chat on the company WhatsApp
A phone call from your own phone
quiz.why: The customer's company WhatsApp chat is the source of truth.

quiz.q: How quickly must every WhatsApp message be answered?
options: By the end of the week
quiz.why: Every message is answered within 1 hour, quoting prices only from the price list.

quiz.q: A customer is not sending their work on WhatsApp. What do you ask them to do?
options: Send 'hi' to the company number so you can save their contact with their GM number
Send it to your personal number
quiz.why: Ask them to send hi to the company number, then save the contact as GM number and name.

quiz.q: How many new customers must be registered and added to the WhatsApp group each week?
quiz.why: At least five new customers registered and five added to the WhatsApp group every week.

quiz.q: What is the first thing to check every morning about the TV?
options: It is on and playing the company advert on repeat
It is switched off to save power
quiz.why: The 32-inch TV plays the company advert on repeat all day.

quiz.q: You want to post a video of a customer collecting their work. What must you have first?
quiz.why: Never post a customer's face, CV or document without their permission.

quiz.q: In which order is the daily clip posted?
options: WhatsApp group, then Facebook, then TikTok
TikTok, then a Facebook Reel, then WhatsApp Status and the group
quiz.why: Post to TikTok, then a Facebook Reel, then WhatsApp Status and the group.

quiz.q: What should the end of every advert video show?
quiz.why: End the text with the company number, which is on the monitor sticker.

quiz.q: New goods arrive. Where do they go?
options: In front of the old goods
Before or behind the old goods, with old goods displayed first
On the floor until there is time
quiz.why: New goods go before or behind old goods, and old goods are displayed with priority.

quiz.q: Which of these must never be displayed anywhere in the shop?
options: Another company's logo, design or advert
quiz.why: Never display any other company's logo, design or advert.

quiz.q: Where do the hanging items go?
options: On the last shelf of the Boys' showcase
quiz.why: Hanging items go on the last shelf of the Boys' showcase. The lower shelf is for faulty items.

quiz.q: A pile of boxes is blocking the Grony 4 path. What do you do?
options: Clear the path and put storage goods on the Grony 4 shelf
quiz.why: The Grony 4 path stays clear and storage goods go on the Grony 4 shelf.

quiz.q: A small electrical fire starts. What must you never use on it?
options: Switching off at the mains if it is safe
quiz.why: Never use water on an electrical fire. Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep, and call 192.

quiz.q: On which day is the fire alarm tested?
quiz.why: The fire alarm is tested every Wednesday.

quiz.q: A customer's printed document is no longer needed. How is it thrown away?
options: Torn into pieces first, then into the BIN
quiz.why: Official and customer documents are torn into pieces before going in the BIN. The waste-papers slot is for test prints only.

quiz.q: You see a cable lying across a walkway. What do you do?
options: Move it off the walkway and bundle it
quiz.why: No cable may lie across any path or walkway.

quiz.q: A printer is faulty. What do you do?
options: Put it on the lower shelf of the Boys' showcase with a note, and tell Joe the same day
quiz.why: Faulty items go on the lower shelf with a note (item, fault, date, name), and Joe is told the same day.

quiz.q: There is a power cut. What do you do with the UPS?
options: Keep it off when there is no work, and put it back on charge the moment power returns
quiz.why: Keep the UPS off when there is no work, and back on charge as soon as power returns.

quiz.q: When may the HP M880 be used?
options: Only in extreme cases, after trying every other printer and telling Joe
quiz.why: The HP M880 is reserved for extreme cases only.

quiz.q: At closing, what do you do with the printers?
options: Turn them off at their button but leave them plugged in and on USB
quiz.why: Printers are off at their button but still plugged in and on USB, with the UPS charging.

quiz.q: A customer buys several items at once. How do you sell them?
options: One Live tap for each item
Through MI: one basket, one receipt
quiz.why: Several items for one customer are sold through MI, one basket and one receipt.

quiz.q: What must every bill have?
options: Its receipt attached, the vendor name, a full item list that adds up, and canonical item names
Nothing, if the vendor is known
quiz.why: Every bill has its receipt, vendor name, full list of goods adding up to the total, and canonical names.

quiz.q: What does WIC mean?
quiz.why: WIC is walk-in customer. GMC is Grony Multimedia as customer.

quiz.q: The app refuses a sale because the price is below cost. What do you do?
options: Do not force it; tell Joe
quiz.why: A sale the app refuses is not forced. Tell Joe.

quiz.q: At how many penalty points is the sanction a 3-day suspension?
quiz.why: 20 points is a 3-day suspension (10 hours deducted). 30 points is a week, 50 points is dismissal.

quiz.q: You could not clock in on time. What may you do?
options: Enter your time by hand any time
Enter it by hand only when you could not clock in, with the reason, and never more than 5 times a month
Ask a colleague to clock in for you
quiz.why: Manual entries need a reason, and more than 5 a month looks highly suspicious.

quiz.q: How do penalty points come off?
options: 5 points come off after a clean record for a week
quiz.why: Points reduce by 5 after a clean record for a week.

quiz.q: Tasks are left undone at the end of the day. Who shares the points?
options: Everyone who clocked in that day, up to 3 points a day each
quiz.why: Everyone clocked in shares missed tasks, at most 3 points a day each.

quiz.q: A friend of a customer asks you for that customer's phone number. What do you do?
options: Give it, they know each other
Refuse politely: customer details are private
quiz.why: Keep customer details private. Never share or reuse them.

quiz.q: Which account do you use in your Chrome profile?
quiz.why: Work in your own Chrome profile with the company account only. No personal email on any browser.

quiz.q: A customer wants to pay to your own Mobile Money number.
options: Say payment goes to the company Mobile Money number or the till
Ask them to pay half now
quiz.why: No personal MoMo number is given. Customers pay the company number.

quiz.q: A customer's laptop was damaged in the shop this afternoon. What do you do?
options: Report it in the evening events question, with details and a photo
quiz.why: Report every unfortunate event in the app. The owner is told straight away.

quiz.q: On which day does the CAB officer confirm cash at bank?
quiz.why: The CAB officer confirms cash at bank every Saturday.

quiz.q: How are cuttings treated?
options: As expenses, recorded whenever cuttings are printed
quiz.why: Cuttings are expenses and must be recorded as such.

quiz.q: Where do customers pay?
options: The company Mobile Money number or the till
quiz.why: Customers pay only to the company Mobile Money number or the till.

quiz.q: What does a bill need besides its total?
options: Its receipt, the vendor name and a full list of goods
quiz.why: Receipt attached, vendor name entered, and a full list of goods adding up to the total.
